blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY, Philippines — The city council is seeking a detailed accounting of Camp John Hay‘s business tax collections and the city’s estimated P225-million claim for unpaid rentals and revenue shares from the property. In a statement Sunday (Nov. 1), the city council discussed the matter during its recent regular session, when Councilor Leandro Yangot Jr. asked City Treasurer Alex Cabarrubias why revenues from Camp John Hay locators were not separately reflected in the city’s revenue presentation. Cabarrubias explained that business taxes paid by Camp John Hay locators were already included in the city’s overall business tax collections. He agreed to […]...
